name: Rural last-mile retail distribution in Africa
title: Rural e-commerce distribution in Africa after Copia: no-go
question: Is rural last-mile retail distribution in Africa viable again after Copia?
answer: Copia Global built rural e-commerce in Kenya through village agents, raised over $100M, and entered administration in May 2024 after failing to raise more money; layoffs of more than 1,000 staff followed. Physical distribution needs a longer runway than venture funds offer, and that gap has not closed.
verdict_reason: The capital-duration mismatch that killed it has not changed.

constraint.name: Patient capital
constraint.detail: Building physical distribution takes longer than a venture fund's life; the money ran out before the network paid.

graveyard.name: Copia Global
graveyard.how: Entered administration, May 2024, after failing to raise new funding
graveyard.raised_note: $123M across eight rounds (TechCabal); others report over $100M
